Name: (FF) Game Tables and Arcade Machines
Author: CyanFire
Description:
This mod adds a Pool Table, Poker Table, Calico Jack Tables, Foosball Table, Air Hockey Table, Vending Machine, Arcade Machines, Slot Machine, Dartboard & Crane Game Machine as furniture to your game.
The Pool, Poker & Low-Stakes Calico Jack Tables have colour variations and the Calico Jack Tables, Dartboard, Arcade, Slot & Crane Game Machines are playable! No more having to complete Prairie King or Junimo Kart to obtain arcade machines for your farmhouse or being blocked by the stupid guy in the movie theatre! The vending machine can be used to purchase Joja Cola or if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7731]Joja Cola Restock[/url] or my [url=https://github.com/CyanFireUK/StardewValleyMods/releases/tag/v2.1.0-unofficial.3-CyanFire]unofficial update[/url], a varied selection of Joja sodas! Did I mention the furniture is rotateable too?


Most items purchaseable from Robin on Wednesday's as well as from the furniture catalogue too. Crane Game is only available from Robin after the Movie Theatre is built. Qi Coin Machine has a 50% of being available from the Casino shop.



Uses vanilla sprites and sprites by Monteso, edited by myself with permission

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3573617]monteso[/url]'s Original mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/179
